newsitem.title: USA: U.S. June T-bonds finish higher in quiet trading.
newsitem.headline: U.S. June T-bonds finish higher in quiet trading.

text.p: April 7 -- U.S. June T-bonds ended strongly higher and near the day's high after a quiet session of shortcovering, traders said. One bond trader said tone is "a little better" but said overall mood remains bearish. Economic line-up slim into Friday, resistance at 107-26/32 and 108-00, support at 107-00.
